videos.desc: A viewing spot at the end of an airport runway under a bright blue sky, with a row of parked airliners on the apron behind. Two men stand on a low concrete wall with big white telephoto lenses on tripods, one crouched behind his camera with his eye to the viewfinder, tracking a jumbo jet as it comes in to land; a third watches beside them. A young man with bleached hair in a denim jacket leans back in the foreground filming himself and staring straight up. The aircraft passes directly overhead, so low that its whole underside, four engines and lowered landing gear fill the frame, while the photographers swing their lenses up to follow it and the man raises one finger and points at it.

A woman in a wide straw hat, white shirt and a denim work apron with tools in the pockets clips a round clipped bush with a pair of long shears in a formal park garden. She works her way along a row of the round bushes, then swaps the shears for a metal watering can and pours a fan of water over a long bed of pink and white flowers. She finishes walking down the gravel path between the clipped bushes towards the camera, smiling, shears in her gloved hand.

A woman in a blue t-shirt stands at a white kitchen sink with the tap running hard into the basin. Cut to a workshop, where a woman in dark overalls kneels on a sawdust-covered floor and drives a cordless drill into the leg of a wooden chair. Then a pair of hands on a grey table hold an opened blue phone with its back off, the battery and circuit board exposed. A teenager in a checked shirt leans over the engine bay of an old blue car in a driveway with a spanner, and finally he punches the air and shouts beside the open bonnet.

A woman with glasses and a pencil in her bun sits at a desk in an empty classroom marking a pupil's paper with a red pen. She corrects sheet after sheet and stacks of marked papers rise on the desk until towers of paper wall her in and she looks up, overwhelmed.

A man in a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in a warehouse holding a handheld barcode scanner. He frowns at it, shakes it, then scans the label on a cardboard box and a red VERIFIED stamp appears; he goes on scanning boxes moving along a long conveyor belt between tall storage racks.

A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.

On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.

A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

A young street-food cook works a wok at a night market stall: a huge column of flame leaps from the pan as he tosses fried rice, he cracks an egg into the wok and stirs it with a ladle, flips the pan into another burst of fire, then plates the rice with a fried egg on top and satay skewers beside it and spreads his arms proudly behind the finished plate.

An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.

A woman in a burgundy trouser suit strides through a busy open-plan office carrying a tablet, pointing and giving instructions to people at their desks. She stops beside a seated colleague and shows him something on the tablet screen. Next she stands at a whiteboard in front of four colleagues and draws a rising line graph with a blue marker, explaining it and pointing at the peak. Finally she stands among the desks, hands on the tablet, talking to the room while everyone works at their screens.

An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her. She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.

Inside a full airliner cabin. A blonde woman sleeps slumped against the window with her mouth open, then the shot pans back through the rows: a bearded man in a suit sleeps with a grey neck pillow, a man in a hoodie sleeps behind him, and further back rows of men in suits and jackets doze in their seats down the length of the dim cabin.

At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.

A young bearded man in a brown canvas apron over a beige T-shirt stands in a sunlit woodworking workshop, clasps his hands together at his chest, leans forward and keeps pleading with a young woman with a canvas bag on her shoulder who stands by the open door facing him. Tools hang above a workbench and sawdust covers the floor. Outside in the yard, a man pushes a trolley stacked with wooden crates and a woman in an apron watches.

In a small flower shop full of buckets of fresh flowers and hanging plants, a smiling young woman with her hair in a bun, in a maroon top and a long cream apron, hands a big bouquet in brown paper across a wooden work table to a young customer in a lilac T-shirt and wide jeans, who gives her a banknote. The customer then holds the bouquet to her chest and smiles. Behind them a young man in an apron works at the table, rolls of ribbon hang on it and a dog sleeps underneath.

On a sunny city street with red double-decker buses, a young woman police officer in a peaked cap, a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in the road with her arms stretched out to stop the traffic. A mother duck leads a line of ducklings across the road in front of her, and a police car with flashing blue lights waits behind. Water sprays from a red fire hydrant, a man in a white shirt crouches by the ducklings in the spray, and people watch from the pavement.

A messy workshop at night under a skylight. A young woman in paint-stained denim overalls with goggles on her head rides a silver suitcase that has a glowing blue wheel, arms out for balance and mouth open in surprise. Behind her a long line of earlier broken suitcase models lies on the floor, sketches of the design are pinned to the wall and a 3D printer sits on a table. Her friends in the background watch from a sofa, then jump and cheer, one holding a bowl of noodles.

In a sunny old workroom where pillows are made, a young bearded man in a linen shirt and canvas apron blows a cloud of tiny, soft white feathers from his open palm into the air. Then he laughs, leans towards the camera and rubs his nose as feathers float around his curly hair. Big cloth sacks overflowing with fluffy white feathers stand around the room, and white pillows lie on an old treadle sewing machine table. An older woman laughs by the window while a black cat reaches up at the feathers.

In a farmyard at misty sunrise, a young man in a cowboy hat, a sleeveless denim shirt, jeans, gloves and muddy boots holds a bale of straw high above his head and throws it down beside a wooden fence. He then wipes his face with his arm and grins. Brown, black and white cows crowd behind the fence next to him. An older man in a hat and sheepskin coat stands by a metal gate holding a mug, with stacked bales and a barn behind him.

A muddy building site at sunrise. A laughing young woman with a braid, in a white hard hat, orange high-visibility vest, grey hoodie and dirty work trousers walks under a wooden roof truss hanging from a crane strap, carrying a tray of four paper coffee cups, a hammer in her tool belt. Three workers in hard hats lean over the scaffolding above her and wave. She stops, looks up and lifts the tray of coffee towards them. A timber house skeleton, a wheelbarrow and planks lie around in the dust and low golden light.

A warehouse loading bay at dawn. A German shepherd dog in a yellow hard hat and orange safety vest stands on its hind legs, pushes a time card into a clock machine on the wall, then drops down and walks off with a card in its mouth. A line of other dogs in yellow hard hats waits behind, and a border collie with a card in its mouth steps up next. A round wall clock and a board of shift times hang on the wall, and a woman in a safety vest, a forklift and pallets are behind.

A bright modern office lobby with a marble floor and a wall of green plants. A smiling young woman in a royal blue blazer and black trousers drops her work ID badge on its lanyard into a steel bin, then walks towards the glass exit doors carrying a cardboard box with a plant, a framed picture and a desk lamp in it. She pushes the glass door open with her free hand and steps out. Behind a wooden reception desk a young man in a navy jumper watches her go.
